qualifier: p53 phosphorylation and ubiquitin-dependent turnover
name: DNA damage checkpoint with p53 phosphorylation and turnover
rationale: Members cover radiation-induced G2 checkpoint signalling, CDK inhibition and p53 transcriptional outputs, distinguished from cell-cycle confusables by regulation of p53 through phosphorylation and degradation (TP53, COP1, Cdc25A turnover) and serine/threonine (de)phosphorylation.

qualifier: GPVI cascade and LDL sensitization
name: Platelet activation and aggregation, GPVI and LDL sensitization
rationale: All members concern platelet activation, aggregation and its positive/negative control; GPVI collagen-receptor signalling and LDL sensitization set it apart from the P2Y/PAR/thromboxane receptor theme and the GPIb-IX-V/VWF adhesion themes.

core: UV lesion repair and DNA synthesis
qualifier: nucleotide excision repair, translesion synthesis, replicative polymerase switching
name: Nucleotide excision repair, translesion synthesis and replicative DNA synthesis
rationale: Members span GG-/TC-NER of UV pyrimidine dimers, POLH/POLK/POLI/REV1 translesion synthesis and replicative primer synthesis/polymerase switching, unlike confusables centred on base excision, mismatch or alkylation repair.

core: Enzymatic nucleobase modification and its reversal
qualifier: APOBEC cytosine deamination, TET demethylation, alkylation reversal
name: Nucleobase editing, DNA demethylation and alkylation damage reversal
rationale: All members chemically modify or restore nucleic-acid bases (APOBEC C-to-U editing in antiviral defence, TET/TDG 5mC oxidation, ALKBH/MGMT direct reversal), distinct from excision-repair, somatic hypermutation and A-to-I editing confusables.

qualifier: intra-S checkpoint and break-induced replication
name: Intra-S checkpoint and break-induced replication repair
rationale: Members cover intra-S damage checkpoint, DNA unwinding and polymerase stimulation, break-induced replication and resolution of recombination intermediates, unlike confusables focused on telomere maintenance or general homologous recombination.

qualifier: COPI, endosome-Golgi retrograde and lysosomal sorting routes
name: Golgi organization and COPI/retrograde vesicle traffic
rationale: Members concern Golgi structure (assembly, ribbon, stacking) and Golgi-centred vesicle budding/fusion to ER, endosomes and lysosomes, whereas confusables concern endocytic recycling to the plasma membrane.

qualifier: glucokinase control and glycogen breakdown/synthesis
name: Glucokinase and glycogen turnover regulation
rationale: Members are glucokinase regulation (GKRP, MODY2) and regulation of glycogenolysis and glycogen synthesis, distinct from insulin signalling, glucagon/PKA and glycogen storage disease confusables.

qualifier: reproductive, social and locomotor
name: Reproductive, social and locomotor behaviour
rationale: Members are mating, parental, aggressive, grooming, exploratory and psychomotor behaviours plus reproductive physiology (erection, insemination, relaxin receptors), unlike confusables about sensory, drinking, ethanol or vocal-learning behaviour.

core: Neural plate and neural tube patterning
qualifier: dorsoventral spinal cord and motor/interneuron fate specification
name: Neural tube patterning and spinal neuron fate specification
rationale: Members cover neural plate formation, axial mesoderm/notochord and floor plate signalling, dorsoventral neural tube patterning and spinal motor/interneuron specification, versus confusables on somitogenesis/Hox, limbs and craniofacial development.

qualifier: BMAL1:CLOCK and CRY:PER feedback loop
name: Core circadian clock BMAL1:CLOCK/CRY:PER feedback loop
rationale: All members describe the transcription-translation feedback loop of BMAL1:CLOCK activation and CRY:PER repression and turnover, unlike confusables about metabolic clock outputs, ROR/REV-ERB or MECP2/NPAS4 transcription.

qualifier: fibril formation and clearance
name: Amyloid-beta production, fibril formation and clearance
rationale: Members concern APP processing, amyloid fibril assembly and amyloid-beta clearance and response (with tangle assembly and microglial activation), whereas confusables centre on glial activation and proliferation.

core: Oncogenic receptor tyrosine kinase variant signalling
qualifier: EGFR, ERBB2, PDGFRA and FGFR mutants, fusions, amplifications
name: Oncogenic EGFR, ERBB2, PDGFRA and FGFR variant signalling
rationale: All members are constitutive signalling by cancer-associated RTK mutants, fusions or amplifications of EGFR/ERBB2/PDGFRA/FGFR1-3 (and LTK), unlike confusables on ALK/ERBB2 drug resistance or cytosolic PDGFR/FLT3 fusions.

qualifier: CSF1 (M-CSF) signalling and bone resorption
name: CSF1-driven macrophage and osteoclast development, bone resorption
rationale: Members cover M-CSF signalling, macrophage proliferation, osteoclast differentiation/fusion and bone resorption with associated interleukin signalling, distinct from monocyte/dendritic differentiation and DAP12 confusables.

qualifier: dopamine biosynthesis
name: Dopamine biosynthesis and presynaptic transmitter release control
rationale: Members combine catecholamine/dopamine synthesis with regulation of transmitter secretion, uptake and spontaneous transmission; biosynthesis distinguishes it from dopamine transport and synaptic structure confusables.

qualifier: ATP release, NTPDase hydrolysis, P1/P2Y receptors
name: Purinergic ATP release, hydrolysis and P1/P2Y receptor signalling
rationale: Most members concern extracellular ATP/adenosine export, hydrolysis and P1/P2Y receptor signalling (with peripheral amine/NO metabolism terms), unlike confusables on other GPCR ligands, calcium signalling or K-ATP channels.

qualifier: positive transcriptional induction after DNA damage
name: p53-driven transcriptional induction of apoptosis after DNA damage
rationale: All members are p53 transcription of death genes or positive regulation of p53/DNA-damage intrinsic apoptosis, distinct from confusables with negative regulation, G1 arrest or BH3-only effector steps.

qualifier: radiation responses, checkpoint, senescence, apoptosis regulation
name: p53-mediated radiation damage checkpoint, senescence and apoptosis regulation
rationale: Members combine responses to gamma, X-ray and UV radiation, G2 checkpoint, senescence and lifespan with positive and negative regulation of p53-dependent apoptosis, unlike confusables that list specific p53 transcriptional targets.

qualifier: ERBB2-coupled, with AKT and estrogen nuclear signalling
name: PTK6 (BRK) signalling downstream of ERBB2
rationale: Most members describe PTK6 expression, activation by ERBB2 and its effectors (STAT3, AKT, RHO/RAS, cell cycle), which distinguishes it from MET and ERBB receptor-proximal signalling confusables.

qualifier: ER/SR store release and store-operated entry
name: Regulation of ER calcium store release and store-operated entry
rationale: Members regulate ryanodine-sensitive store release, calcium sequestration, store-operated entry and calcium sensing, unlike confusables centred on calcium extrusion/exchangers or cardiac contraction.

qualifier: glutamate, glutamine, proline, aspartate and ammonium handling
name: Glutamate-family and aspartate metabolism with ammonium handling
rationale: Members cover glutamate/glutamine, proline, arginine and aspartate metabolism plus nitrogen utilization and ammonium homeostasis, distinct from urea-cycle/ornithine disorder and glyoxylate confusables.

core: Smooth muscle tone and blood pressure
qualifier: contraction, vasoconstriction and endothelin
name: Smooth muscle tone and vasoconstrictor blood pressure control
rationale: Members regulate smooth muscle contraction and relaxation, vasoconstriction and pulmonary/endothelin-driven pressure, while confusables centre on NO-cGMP-mediated vasorelaxation.

qualifier: fructose bisphosphates and lactate production
name: Glycolytic flux control via fructose bisphosphates and lactate
rationale: Members concern regulation of glycolysis and pentose-phosphate flux through fructose-2,6- and 1,6-bisphosphate, with fermentation to lactate, distinct from hypoxia/mTOR/p53/FOXO and hexokinase confusables.

qualifier: collagen and elastic fibre synthesis, crosslinking, MMP degradation
name: Collagen and elastic fibre synthesis, crosslinking and degradation
rationale: All members address collagen and elastin fibre biosynthesis, assembly, crosslinking and MMP-mediated degradation, unlike generic ECM expression modules and aortic development confusables.

qualifier: JAK-STAT
name: Growth hormone receptor JAK-STAT signalling and regulation
rationale: All three members are growth hormone receptor signalling via JAK-STAT and its regulation, distinct from insulin, IL-6, IL-2/STAT5 and leptin confusables.

qualifier: PUMA/NOXA BH3-only inhibition of BCL-2, cytochrome c release
name: p53-driven apoptosis via PUMA/NOXA BH3-only proteins
rationale: Members link p53 transcription of death genes to PUMA/NOXA activation, BCL-2 inactivation and cytochrome c release, distinct from GO p53-regulation confusables and BAX/BAK/apoptosome execution confusables.
